candidate.title: UMI-4C
candidate.scope: The single, unbranched Illumina UMI-4C schematic, from protein-associated chromosomal DNA through crosslinking, HC DpnII digestion, proximity ligation, deproteinization, sonication, single-end adapter ligation and nested PCR to DNA. Collection page 132 is a verified matching secondary catalogue page: its UMI-4C heading, caption and operation labels match the attached diagram. Targeted chromosome conformation capture with unique molecular identifiers is the expanded name of this one target, not a second workflow. No kit named in surrounding catalogue text is an alternative depicted method. The biological target is chromosomal contact distributions at chosen loci; the measured library carrier is amplified ligation-product DNA. The supplied primary-paper content is abstract-only, so neither exact UMI encoding nor an unshown sequencing/read-layout operation is asserted.

operations.information_effect: Preserves spatial association of DNA segments within the protein-associated complex for subsequent contact capture.

operations.label: HC DpnII digestion
operations.description: Digest DNA in the crosslinked chromatin; the output shows separated short DNA segments still associated through the protein complex.

operations.information_effect: Changes continuous chromosomal DNA into fragments while preserving their crosslinked proximity association.
